user.title: Add a news feed
user.description: Paste an RSS, Atom or JSON feed address, or just a website address and we'll find its feed. Feeds you already have in Feedreader are listed.

data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for a site you know whose certificate is broken. Without the check, someone along the way could listen in.

select_feed.title: Choose a feed
select_feed.description: That's a web page, not a feed. Here's what we found on the site:

data_description.url: The feed to add. You can add the others later the same way.

user_agent.title: The site refused
user_agent.description: {host} refused News Card ({status}). Some sites only answer requests that look like a browser. You can try again with a different User-Agent, the name Home Assistant introduces itself with. It's sent only when the normal request is refused, and you can change it later in the feed options.

data_description.user_agent: Pick **Browser** to look like Chrome, or type your own.

moved.title: The feed moved
moved.description: There's no feed at this address anymore. Here's what we found on the site's homepage:

data_description.url: The feed that replaced the old address.
A direct feed address. The feed keeps its entities, alerts and options.

error.invalid_url: That address doesn't look right. Use the full address, with http:// or https://.
error.timeout: The site took too long to answer. Try again in a moment.
error.ssl_error: The site's security certificate has a problem. If you know the site, you can turn off the check.
error.not_a_feed: We couldn't find a feed at this address.
error.invalid_feed: There's something at this address, but it isn't a feed we can read.
error.too_large: The feed is too big (over 10 MB).
error.blocked: The site lets only browsers in and blocks feed readers ({status}). There's no way around that from Home Assistant. If the site has another feed address, try that one.
error.auth_required: This feed needs a username and password ({status}), and feeds that need a login aren't supported.
error.not_found: There's nothing at this address ({status}). The feed may have moved; enter the website address and we'll look for it.
error.rate_limited: The site is asking us to slow down ({status}). Try again in a few minutes.
error.server_error: The site is having trouble ({status}). Try again later.
error.refused: The site refused the request ({status}). You can try a different User-Agent in the feed options.
error.still_refused: The site still refuses ({status}). Try another User-Agent. If nothing works, the site lets only real browsers in.
error.invalid_user_agent: A User-Agent is one line of up to 512 characters.

get_entries.name: Get articles
get_entries.description: Returns the articles you already have from one or more feeds, without downloading them again.

keyword.name: Keyword
keyword.description: Only articles with this text in the title or summary.

since.name: Since
since.description: Only articles published after this time.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Checks for new articles right now.

mark_read.name: Mark as read
mark_read.description: Marks articles you've read. The card dims them on every device, and the unread count goes down.

article_id.name: Article IDs
article_id.description: Which articles to mark (the `id` from the trigger or from get_entries). Empty = the whole feed.

send_to_phone.name: Send to phone
send_to_phone.description: Sends the latest article to phones with the Home Assistant app, with its image and a link.

count.name: Number of articles
count.description: How many of the latest articles from each feed. More than one arrive as a short list.

include_summary.name: With the summary
include_summary.description: Great for weather forecasts and feeds with short texts.

keyword.name: Keyword
keyword.description: Only articles with this text in the title or summary.

phones.name: Phones
phones.description: Phones with the Home Assistant app.

include_image.name: With the image
include_image.description: The article image shows up in the notification.

announce.name: Announce on speakers
announce.description: Reads the latest article on speakers, in your Home Assistant language. Music pauses for a moment and picks up again.

new_article.name: New article
new_article.description: Fires when a feed publishes a new article. You can limit it to articles that mention certain words.

keywords.description: Only when one of the words is in the title or summary. Empty = every new article.

no_new_articles.name: No new articles
no_new_articles.description: Fires when a feed has been quiet for too long, for example when the site is down.

for.name: For
for.description: How long without a new article.

recent_article.name: Recent article
recent_article.description: Checks if a feed published an article recently. You can limit it to articles that mention certain words.

within.name: Within
within.description: How fresh the article needs to be.

keywords.name: Keywords
keywords.description: Only articles with one of the words in the title or summary. Empty = any article.
